Strict comparison/numeric op against the result of an array element read (jeu[...]) of a mutable global array. The element type cannot be proven numeric (arrays are not expressible as static shapes), and a number type guard on the element-load expression has no IR effect, so the operand is maybe-not-number and the op stays generic.
